**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `01dfe73`: all 26 files reviewed.

0 findings; 0 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 3.** I found nothing to flag in part 1. The new `recordingHideMainWindow` IPC channel takes no renderer input, and `shared/types` only gained type exports. The shade window reuse logic is consistent: it resets to idle while hidden, sends state before showing, and a `show` followed by `hide` before the first paint never shows the window. I did not run the tests.

**Batch 2 of 3.** No findings in this part. I read the full diff for all six files. For recorder-store.ts I also read the begin-take and failure path in the file itself. The start, cancel and failure paths look consistent: a countdown-time acquisition is discarded on cancel, on a changed input and on a failure, and the live-settings forwarder is stopped in each case. I did not read the files of the other two parts, so the new `recordingHideMainWindow` call and the preload and shade-window changes it relies on were not checked.

**Batch 3 of 3.** No findings in this part. I read `recorder-store.ts` (lines 225–375) to check the new tests and the new "Start sequence" doc against it. The tests match the behaviour they name: acquiring during the countdown, the input check at countdown end, the 50 ms hide settle, and cancel and failure release. The doc matches the code on the names it cites (`WINDOW_HIDE_SETTLE_MS`, `acquireDuringCountdown`, `needsNewAcquisition`, `discardStart`, `beginTake`). I did not check the doc's claims about `recorder-engine.ts`, the main process or mediabunny.
